MODULE: mechanisms/seam_teachers.py -- the ADR-0008 C3 SEAM-TEST controlled-teacher arms
(EVALUATOR-ONLY). It imports torch but builds only SMALL, device-agnostic dense Kraus/field
tensors on CPU (BitFlip.RX backdrop, exp(-i phi ZZ) coherent seam edge, its Pauli twirl, and
the D5 T-B/T-A two-state Markov member) -- NO GPU-required unit exists, so every unit is
CPU-PURE and IN-SCOPE for full L0+L1+L2 (the l3 inventory classes all 11 units C). out_of_scope
is therefore {}.
ELEVEN public units (top-level public defs; the frozen dataclass SeamTeacher has NO public
method in its body, so it contributes zero units): three (a)-class closed-form/record-chain
primitives (tb_markov_kraus, tb_record_chain_stats, tb_member_from_rate_and_ratio), the backdrop
channel builder (backdrop_kraus), five equal-treatment teacher factories (backdrop_teacher,
coherent_seam_teacher, bias_injected_coherent_teacher, twirled_seam_teacher, tb_bunching_teacher,
pauli_ablation_teacher) and the roster (seam_teacher_arms). Only two units carry a real Python
branch: tb_member_from_rate_and_ratio (the ratio>1 sqrt guard) and seam_teacher_arms (the
bias_delta-is-not-None guard) -- both arcs exercised. The rest are straight-line (0/0 branch,
coverage.py empty-denominator convention); their faithfulness rests on the L1 property /
independent-Kraus value pin.
The private helpers (_const_field, _edge_on, _backdrop_params) are not public units and are NOT
reconciled/scored -- they are exercised + mutation-covered via the public factories.
FAITHFULNESS: CPTP (sum K^dag K = I) on every built channel; genuine NON-UNITALITY of the T-B
member (sum K K^dag != I where p01 != p10) DISCRIMINATED against the unital R=1 ablation; the D5
record-chain identities (r, R, lambda1, T3) pinned against an INDEPENDENT numpy chain computation;
and every factory's name / channel_field / edge_field / params VALUE-PINNED against a from-scratch
numpy recompute (NOT the module's own builders) so a wrong coefficient/sign/index/kron-order/arg-
swap is caught.
